port.name: Tailwind CSS v4
port.description: Living Code for Tailwind CSS v4. Repository-owned theme files, installation instructions and four color flavors.

guide.configuration: See [Tailwind CSS v4's documentation](https://tailwindcss.com) for application settings and reload behavior. The activation instructions above identify each supported flavor; keep your other application configuration.
guide.compatibility: Preserves the npm package name `@living-code/tailwind` and its existing import paths. Package publication and registry credentials are separate from creating this repository.
